_doc: Render budget for tests/client_smoke/render_budget.py (art bible section 7). art_bible: the targets. ceilings: what fails the Test check today. Ceilings only go down: world lowers them when it slims the world. baseline: the worst frame per shot (llvmpipe, 1280x720); a PR that raises draw calls or primitives more than `regression` over it fails. History: on 2026-11-23 the spawn shot was 1.98M primitives (about 3x the scene's ~600k triangles: every MultiMesh spanned the whole world, so the camera and each of 4 shadow cascades drew all of it) and 30 materials. 2026-11-23, ws/world/chunked-instancing: the scatter forest and flora are chunked by area with per-layer draw distances and the sun uses 2 shadow cascades: primitives 2.0M -> 613k night / 587k noon, draw calls up from 219 to 273 night / 257 noon (each chunk is a draw call; still under 300), 18 materials. Ceilings lowered to primitives 650k and materials 20; baseline reset to those numbers. 2026-11-23, ws/world/emberlight-everything: lanterns, the workbench, avatars and NodeFx hit bits moved onto the shared Emberlight materials: 18 -> 11 world materials, materials ceiling lowered to 12. 2026-11-23, ws/world/chunked-node-props: resource-node props chunked (close-up layers 128 m with 60/110 m ranges, stones and stumps 256 m, tree parts and glows whole) and a chunk with nothing shown (stumps before anything is felled) hidden: primitives 625k -> 461k night / 599k -> 435k noon, draw calls 277 -> 286 night / 261 -> 270 noon. Primitives ceiling lowered to 500k; baseline reset to those numbers. cheaper: each {cheap shot: full shot} pair must save (scene triangles at least min_saving lower, fewer primitives, no more draw calls). 2026-11-23, ws/qa/low-render-cheaper: low (Low preset, noon) vs noon (Medium): scene triangles 541k vs 610k (-11%, flora halved), primitives 432k vs 435k (-0.7%), draw calls 268 vs 272. 2026-11-24, ws/client/painted-surfaces (owner direction, the test-camp look in the game): bark and stone get their own shared Emberlight materials painted with SurfaceTex detail, 12 -> 14 world materials; the materials ceiling is raised to 14 on purpose (still well under the art bible's 24): no extra draw calls, the layers were already separate MultiMeshes. 2026-11-25, client/grass (owner direction, the test-camp look in the game): grass tufts near the camera (Grass, 24 m around a point ahead of the camera, faded at the edge): one MultiMesh, so one draw call, about 30k triangles, no shadow, and its own material. Ceilings raised on purpose: primitives 500k -> 560k (still under the art bible's 600k), materials 14 -> 15 (art bible 24). Baseline reset to the measured frames: noon 248 dc / 491k primitives, night 262 / 524k. Low draws half the grass and stays cheaper. 2026-11-26, client/new-characters (owner direction, the model direction in the game): every traveller is the sculpted body (Traveller, about 4,200 triangles in 1 draw call, against the old kit's 2,300): about +8k primitives at night (the body in the camera and both shadow cascades). Fits under the 560k ceiling the grass PR set; draw calls and materials unchanged. 2026-11-26, client/goofy-folk (owner direction: the goofy cartoon characters): survivors and Zombai are Toon figures (about 4,200 and 2,100 triangles, 1 draw call each) on their own shared "folk" Emberlight material with the paint grain and brush off (the grain read as pixel noise on faces). Materials ceiling raised on purpose 15 -> 16 (art bible 24); draw calls and primitives unchanged within noise. 2026-11-26, client/carved-characters (owner switched to B): Carved figures (about 1,150 triangles, 1 draw call) on the "carved" no-grain material, which replaces "folk": still 16 materials, a few thousand fewer primitives. 2026-11-27, client/grass-no-pop-in (owner: "I don't like how I can see the grass loading in"): grass thins out by rank from 12 m to 52 m instead of ending in a wall at 24 m, far cells hold only the tufts that can show: about +6k tufts on the spawn meadow, primitives noon 486k -> 516k, night 518k -> 549k, draw calls and materials unchanged. Baseline reset to those frames.
